questions.question: Flutter là gì và tại sao cross-platform?

options.B: Flutter: Dart-based UI framework, compile to native ARM, own rendering engine (Skia/Impeller) — 1 codebase cho iOS, Android, Web, Desktop

questions.explanation: Flutter: Google's UI toolkit. Dart language. Single codebase → iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, Embedded. Own rendering engine (không dùng platform widgets) → pixel-perfect UI, consistent across platforms. Hot reload: thay đổi thấy ngay (< 1s). Compile: ahead-of-time (AOT) cho release → native performance. vs React Native: Flutter render own UI, React Native bridge to native components. Flutter 3.x: stable for all platforms.

questions.question: Widget tree và StatelessWidget vs StatefulWidget?

options.B: Everything is widget. StatelessWidget: immutable, no state. StatefulWidget: has State object, can rebuild với setState()

questions.explanation: Flutter UI = tree of widgets. StatelessWidget: build() gọi 1 lần, rebuild chỉ khi parent rebuild. StatefulWidget: có State<T> object. setState(() { count++; }) → trigger rebuild. Lifecycle: initState(), didChangeDependencies(), build(), didUpdateWidget(), dispose(). Widget types: Layout (Row, Column, Stack, Container), Display (Text, Image, Icon), Input (TextField, ElevatedButton), Navigation (Navigator, Route). Composition pattern: nhỏ, reusable widgets thay vì 1 widget lớn.

questions.question: Flutter Layout — Row, Column, Stack, Expanded, Flexible?

options.A: Chỉ cần Container cho mọi layout
options.B: Row: horizontal. Column: vertical. Stack: overlap. Expanded: fill remaining space. Flexible: proportional. SizedBox: fixed size. mainAxis/crossAxis alignment

questions.explanation: Row/Column: children layout horizontally/vertically. mainAxisAlignment: start/center/end/spaceBetween/spaceAround. crossAxisAlignment: start/center/end/stretch. Expanded: flex:1 mặc định, fill available space. Flexible: không force fill, can be smaller. Stack: absolute positioning với Positioned(top, left, right, bottom, child). SafeArea: avoid notch/status bar. SingleChildScrollView: scrollable content. ListView.builder: efficient scrollable list. Wrap: flow layout khi không đủ chỗ.

questions.question: State management trong Flutter — Provider, Riverpod, BLoC?

options.B: setState: local/simple. Provider: dependency injection + state. Riverpod: improved Provider (compile-safe). BLoC: stream-based, separation of concerns. Zustand-like: GetX (simple)

questions.explanation: setState: chỉ cho local, simple state. Provider (ChangeNotifier): ChangeNotifierProvider → Consumer/context.watch. Good for medium apps. Riverpod: type-safe, no BuildContext dependency, auto-dispose. BLoC (Business Logic Component): Events → BLoC → States via Streams. flutter_bloc package. Recommended bởi Google cho large apps. GetX: simple, less boilerplate nhưng opinionated. Trend 2024: Riverpod growing fast. Choose: small app → Provider/setState, large app → Riverpod/BLoC.

questions.question: Flutter Navigation — Navigator 2.0, GoRouter?

options.B: Navigator 1.0: push/pop. Navigator 2.0: declarative, Router API. GoRouter: popular package trên Navigator 2.0, named routes, deep linking, guarded routes
options.C: Flutter không hỗ trợ deep linking

questions.explanation: Navigator 1.0 (imperative): Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => Screen())). Named routes: Navigator.pushNamed('/profile', arguments: userId). Navigator 2.0 (declarative): Router widget, RouterDelegate, RouteInformationParser — phức tạp nhưng powerful. GoRouter (recommended 2024): const router = GoRouter(routes: [GoRoute(path:'/', builder: ...), GoRoute(path:'/user/:id', builder: ...)]). context.go('/user/123'). ShellRoute: persistent navigation (bottom nav). Deep linking: auto handle URL → screen.

questions.question: Flutter và REST API — dio package, error handling?

options.B: dio: interceptors, FormData, download/upload, timeout, retry. Combine với Riverpod: repository pattern, loading/error/data states, freezed for models
options.C: http package là đủ cho production

questions.explanation: dio setup: Dio dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com', connectTimeout: 5000, receiveTimeout: 3000)). Interceptors: dio.interceptors.add(InterceptorsWrapper(onRequest: addToken, onError: handleRefresh)). Error handling: DioException types (timeout, cancel, badResponse). Repository pattern: abstract interface → implementation với dio. Response model: fromJson với json_serializable hoặc freezed (immutable). Riverpod FutureProvider: async data với loading/error/data states. Pagination: dio_cookie_manager + page cursor.

questions.question: Flutter app bị jank (dropped frames). Debug thế nào?

options.B: Flutter DevTools Performance tab: identify expensive widgets, jank frames. Avoid rebuilds: const constructors, RepaintBoundary, ListView.builder thay ListView

questions.explanation: Jank: < 60fps (16ms per frame). Flutter DevTools → Performance tab → UI/GPU thread time. Frame rendering: Skia rasterization. Common causes: (1) Expensive build() methods: compute in background, cache results. (2) Too many widgets rebuild: const widgets không rebuild, RepaintBoundary isolate subtree. (3) Large images: ResizeImage, cacheWidth/cacheHeight. (4) Opacity: AnimatedOpacity tốt hơn Opacity(đặc biệt animating). (5) ListView: builder thay children (lazy). (6) Heavy operations on main thread: compute() isolate. Profile mode: flutter run --profile.

questions.question: Flutter app release — code signing, CI/CD, app store submission?

options.B: Android: keystore sign, Gradle config. iOS: certificates + provisioning profiles, Xcode. Fastlane hoặc GitHub Actions tự động build/sign/deploy. App store policies
options.D: iOS không cần signing nếu dùng Flutter

questions.explanation: Android release: (1) Generate keystore: keytool -genkey. (2) Configure key.properties. (3) Gradle signingConfigs. (4) flutter build apk --release hoặc appbundle. iOS release: (1) Apple Developer account. (2) Certificates (Development/Distribution). (3) Provisioning profiles. (4) Xcode Archive → distribute. Fastlane: match (manage certificates), gym (build), deliver (upload to App Store). GitHub Actions: checkout → setup flutter → get deps → run tests → build → sign → upload. Firebase App Distribution: beta testing. Play Console / App Store Connect: release management, staged rollout.
